fields.summary_ko.0: SK Hynix (NASDAQ:SKHY) stock surged 23.7% on SoftBank acquisition reports, closing up 20%, with reported acquisition price around $1 trillion representing 1.7x premium to $576 billion market cap.
fields.summary_ko.1: SoftBank targeting vertical integration across semiconductor supply chain including DRAM, NAND flash, and HBM, though acquisition stalled due to regulatory and national security concerns.
